strategy: reuse bundled official Pandoc engine with Qingye GUI

interfaceStyles: MacOS (drawn traffic lights, unified title bar; optional Windows 11 acrylic behind title bar and home page)

fixes: Switching from any optional home page back to Classic in Settings left the optional page on screen
